sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A glabrous, glaucous subshrub of desert or sandy ground, often saline, from the Levant and Arabian Peninsula to southern Iran. It reaches about 45–60 cm.

sections.title: Leaves and fruit
sections.text: The fleshy, linear to lance-shaped leaves are up to 40–43 × 2–5 mm. The dry, winged fruit is about 9–15 mm long.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use is established in the sources consulted.
